narrative.overview:
The workspace applies the user's Lightroom direction through restrained neutral surfaces, a prominent exposure scale and precise controls. Diagnostic colors are the artifact being edited. System sans typography keeps the surrounding tool quiet.

This is the browser workspace system, extracted from `frontend/src/index.css`, `WorkspaceShell.tsx`, the shared button/card components and the fields in `App.tsx`. The manual has its own contract in `docs/DESIGN.md`. This records the shipped implementation; it does not establish seed-process compliance. The direction contract discloses that the seed was not run.
keyCharacteristics: A visible labeled exposure preview beside or above precise editing.
Compact task navigation and optional media.
Numeric entry, selection and recovery feedback remain explicit.

rules.name: The Artifact Color Rule
rules.body: Keep diagnostic colors in the exposure artifact and its editing controls; use neutral chrome around them.

rules.name: The Precision Rule
rules.body: Keep exact values readable and editable through numeric or text fields alongside graphical controls.

rules.name: The Preview and Edit Rule
rules.body: Keep the graph and selected-band editing together in Bands on phone, and keep the preview beside editing on desktop. Palette uses its compact exposure preview.

dos: Do keep diagnostic colors in the artifact and its editing controls.
Do retain labeled units, exact input values and visible selection.
Do preserve focus visibility, touch targets and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't require media import before editing the exposure scale.
Don't replace the labeled exposure scale with a decorative grayscale ramp.
Don't treat illustration or emulated screenshots as calibrated display evidence.
